data.name: Irfaan
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘arfa’ meaning 'to purify'. Irfaan is the name of an angel in Islamic tradition who is believed to be in charge of purifying the souls of martyrs. The name signifies a gentle and compassionate soul who is free from worldly desires and is devoted to spiritual growth.

The name Irfaan is a reflection of the deep respect and importance given to the ideas of spiritual purification and personal growth in Islamic culture.

The name signifies a strong commitment to spiritual growth and a desire for inner peace and self-improvement.
